title: entry.create, contract version 2
description: Creates an entry of any type with the first revision of each of its variants (PRD 5.4, 6.4, 10.1): the entry's id, which the caller makes, its type, its home node, which owns its content (PRD 5.10), the fields of its shared variant and the fields of each language's variant. A type with localization none has the shared variant alone and takes no language; a type with localization variants needs at least one language. A create of an id that exists is version_conflict, and the kernel checks each variant's fields against the fields that variant holds when it writes them. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Entries\Domain\Commands\CreateLocalizedEntry, and the generated codec CreateEntryCodecV2 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

entry.description: The new entry's id, which the caller makes.

home.description: The id of the node that owns the entry's content.

locales.description: The first revision of each language's variant, each locale once: none for a type with localization none, at least one for a type with localization variants. A locale twice is refused with json_invalid, and a language of a type without localization with validation_failed.

shared.description: The fields of the first revision of the shared variant: every field of a type with localization none, the fields that are not translatable of a type with localization variants.

type.description: The id of the entry's type.

extension_fields.description: The extension fields, an object of fields by handle for each extender's namespace.

field_handle.description: A field's handle: lowercase snake_case of at most 63 characters without a double underscore, never ext and never starting with cms_.

field_namespace.description: An extender's namespace: 1 to 20 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, never ext.

field_value.description: A field's value: a string, an integer, a boolean, null, a list of values or an object of values by a key of 1 to 255 bytes.

fields.description: The fields by handle, in the input form the type's validator reads: the owner's fields, and each extender's fields under ext by its namespace. A text, a decimal (its canonical string), a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a date-time (RFC 3339) are strings, an integer is an integer, a boolean a boolean, a list a list and a group an object of its fields. The kernel checks the values against the type's schema when it writes them.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

locale_fields.description: The first revision of one language's variant.

fields.description: The fields of the language's variant: the type's translatable fields.
